messages:
alex: Heads up — proposing an RBAC refactor for the private control plane. Split "priv-admin" into "pcp-admin" and "pcp-ops" to reduce blast radius. This touches VPC allowlist checks and on-prem operator privileges. Planning a canary Wed 03:00 PST. Need security sign-off and a migration plan. CC @maria @sam

maria: Thanks. Two quicks: 1) will org owners be auto-mapped? 2) audit logs preserved & searchable? Also KMS access scope needs review (who can decrypt).

alex: Mapping plan: org owners -> pcp-admin by default unless explicit deny. Audit logs remain but new role names will appear. We'll ship a 30d migration shim that maps old role names to new ones for compatibility. KMS note: decrypt/unwrap will be gated to pcp-admin; we'll add explicit key policy stanzas. Example policy snippet:```json
{
  "role": "pcp-admin",
  "allowed_actions": ["control_plane:config:write","kms:decrypt"],
  "conditions": {"source_ip": "vpc-allowlist"}
}
```

sam: Concern — on-prem installs currently rely on a local admin token. How will operators authenticate after the change in air-gapped environments? Need a clear migration path for on-prem HSM/Credentials.

jess: Product note — Dedicated customers will see UI permission changes. We need in-place UX messaging and an auto-migration toggle. Also docs for support.

maria: From compliance: add KMS key usage audit events and preserve key access logs for 90 days. Also verify HSM key policies for on-prem HSMs; ensure we don't break key wrapping/unwrapping for existing tokens.

alex: Rollout plan: 1) internal canary orgs (10 orgs) 2) opt-in Dedicated customers 3) general release. Rollback: keep shim that maps pcp-admin -> priv-admin; can flip off new role checks. Telemetry: emit events `rbac_migration` and `pcp_role_assigned`.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for 1760494800 (2026-04-14T03:00Z) — applying RBAC schema v3.1 to private-control-plane.

sam: Add runtime guard: alert if pcp-admin actions originate outside VPC allowlist or without MFA. Pager if unauthorized KMS decrypt attempted.

maria: Agreed. Also request SIEM ingestion for KMS audit logs and set retention to 90d. We'll run a quick vuln triage on the admin token flow pre- and post-migration.

alex: I'll open the RFC + migration scripts and include the shim. Links: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/pcp-rbac-refactor and PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/pcp/pull/421

jess: Timeline looks ok from PM. I'll draft customer comms and admin console copy. LGTM :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — tagging @eng-oncall to watch the canary for the first 24h and to escalate any unauthorized KMS access.
